admin.recherchePlaceholder: Search by title, author or ID...
admin.chargeParLaBase: These gaps are computed by the database, with the same function as the publication check: what is shown here is exactly what will be refused.
admin.utilisateursSousTitre: Parent accounts. No child data is collected, here no more than anywhere else.
admin.abonnementsSousTitre: The status shown is the one the database OBSERVES, dates folded in — never the one reported by the provider.
admin.promosSousTitre: Discount codes, their usage and their expiry.
admin.promoCodeAide: Between 3 and 32 characters, letters and digits only: a code gets dictated over the phone and typed by hand.
admin.promoValeurAide: In percentage points (20 for 20%), or in the smallest unit of the currency (499 for €4.99). The CFA franc has no subunit.
admin.promoPorteeAide: Currency and zone apply ONLY to a fixed amount, and the database requires both: "€5 off" means nothing on a basket in CFA francs, and the Africa zone covers XAF and XOF. A percentage holds in every zone — these two fields are then ignored.
admin.promoExpireAide: Leave empty for a code with no deadline. The code stays usable until the end of the chosen day.
admin.promoActifCreation: Active as soon as it is created
admin.anonymiseNote: An anonymised account no longer has an address or a name: its orders survive as accounting records, the person does not.
admin.conteNouveauSousTitre: Uploading the PDF creates a draft: title, pages and text are read from it.
admin.conteFichierAide: One hundred megabytes at most. Title and page count are read from it.
admin.conteTitreImposeAide: Leave empty to keep the PDF's own title.
admin.livretNouveauSousTitre: Same pipeline as a tale: the PDF creates a draft, the type is set up front.
admin.livretEditionSousTitre: Business fields, prices per zone, and publication.
admin.livretChampsIndependants: These three levers are INDEPENDENT: a booklet can be both included in the subscription and sold individually.
admin.livretPublicationBloquee: This booklet cannot be published while something is missing. The list above is the one the database will enforce.
admin.livretPublicationPrete: Nothing is missing: this booklet can be published.
admin.livretTraductionsAide: Title and summary come from the uploaded file. The slug, however, is never editable: it is in the booklet's public address.
admin.livretVersionAjoutAide: The PDF is attached to THIS booklet: same prices, same publication, same rights. The very same upload made from "Add a learning booklet" would create a second title, and a buyer of the French version would hold no right over the English one.
admin.livretSuppressionAide: No way back. A failed upload must be able to disappear; a published or archived booklet must not — it is referenced by rights and orders. Archive that one instead.
admin.livretFichierAide: One hundred megabytes at most. Title and page count are read from it.
admin.livretOrientationAide: Declared on upload, editable afterwards. An activity booklet is usually landscape.
admin.conteEditionSousTitre: Business fields, prices per zone, and publication.
admin.conteDepose: The file is ingested. What is missing must now be filled in before publishing.
admin.conteVersionAjoutee: The version is added to this tale.
admin.conteOrigineAide: The people or region the tale comes from. Never "Africa" in general.
admin.conteTypeDocumentAide: A tale is a story; a learning booklet is teaching material. The catalogue presents them separately.
admin.conteOrientationAide: The page layout of the uploaded PDF. A tale is almost always portrait; this field exists only for the rare landscape picture books.
admin.contePagesExtraitAide: Leave empty for the site's default.
admin.conteGratuitAide: Readable online without an account. Never grants downloads.
admin.conteInclusAbonnementAide: Online reading for subscribers, as soon as the title is published.
admin.conteDisponibleAchatAide: The only lever that grants PDF and EPUB downloads.
admin.conteChampsIndependants: These three levers are INDEPENDENT: a tale can be both included in the subscription and sold individually.
admin.contePrixAide: Amount in the smallest unit of the currency: 499 for €4.99, 1500 for 1,500 CFA francs. The CFA franc has no subunit.
admin.contePublicationPrete: Nothing is missing: this tale can be published.
admin.contePublicationBloquee: This tale cannot be published while something is missing. The list above is the one the database will enforce.
admin.conteTraductionsAide: Title and summary come from the uploaded file. The slug, however, is never editable: it is in the tale's public address.
admin.conteVersionResumeAide: The text a customer reads before buying. It is never extracted from the PDF. Empty the field to remove it.
admin.conteVersionAjoutAide: The PDF is attached to THIS tale: same prices, same publication, same rights. The very same upload made from "Add a tale" would create a second title, and a buyer of the French version would hold no right over the English one.
admin.conteSuppressionAide: No way back. A failed upload must be able to disappear; a published or archived tale must not — it is referenced by rights and orders. Archive that one instead.
admin.conteSuppressionMotifAide: Recorded in the audit log. Three characters at least.
admin.financesSousTitre: What the period produced. No consolidated total: adding euros and CFA francs without an exchange rate produces nothing.
admin.titresLusVide: No aggregatable reading over the period.
admin.seuilNote: Below five people a segment is not an aggregate: it is hidden rather than removed, so that a missing row is not mistaken for an empty segment.
admin.graphiqueLegende: Relative values, the tallest bar being the maximum of the series.
admin.financesIndisponible: These figures are not available at the moment.
admin.offresSousTitre: The commercial catalogue: which plans exist, what they open, and their price per zone.
admin.aucuneOffre: No plan yet. Create one below, then give it a price before putting it on sale.
admin.offreSuppressionAide: A plan that has been subscribed to cannot be deleted: take it off sale instead — ongoing contracts are unaffected.
admin.offreCreee: The plan has been created. It is off sale: give it a price, then put it on sale.
admin.offreCodeAide: Lower case, no accents, words separated by hyphens — for instance “association-annuel”. It appears in the checkout URL and cannot be renamed.
admin.offreDomaineAide: The two subscriptions are watertight: reading does not open the association, the association does not open the catalogue, and neither grants the right to download. This choice is final.
admin.offrePeriodeAide: Final as well: a monthly plan turned yearly would charge twelve times what the member agreed to.
admin.offreOrdreAide: Smallest first, in the subscription funnel.
admin.offrePrixAide: One amount per zone, in the smallest unit of its currency: 799 for €7.99, but 2500 for 2,500 CFA francs — the CFA franc has no subunit. A plan with no price in a zone is not sold there.
admin.associationSousTitre: The contents of the association space: what is open, and what is reserved for members.
admin.aucunContenu: No content yet. Create one below; it starts as a draft.
admin.contenuSlugAide: Lower case, no accents, words separated by hyphens. This is the public address of the content, and the former blog addresses redirect to it: it cannot be renamed.
admin.contenuChapeauAide: Visible to everyone, even on reserved content: it is what makes people want to join.
admin.contenuAccesAide: “Open” is readable by everyone. “Members” reserves the body of the text for the association subscription — the title and standfirst stay public.
admin.contenuImageAide: Leave empty for the category’s default illustration.
admin.contenuCree: The content has been created, as a draft, with its French version.
admin.contenuDepublie: The content has been withdrawn from the association space.
admin.contenuSuppressionAide: Deleting removes every version of the text, and it is final.
admin.contenuVersionAide: The French version is authoritative: without it, publication is refused. The English one falls back on it until it exists.
admin.contenuVersionCorpsAide: One section per block, separated by a blank line. The first line of the block is the section title; the following lines are paragraphs, except those starting with “- ”, which become a bullet list.
admin.contenuVedetteAide: Featured contents open the grid of the association space.
admin.contenuOrdreAide: Smallest first, among contents published on the same date.
admin.conteThemesAide: Comma-separated — “trickery, animals, seasons”. They replace the region: they apply to tales and activity books alike, and they are what the catalogue filters on. Clearing the field removes every theme.
admin.conteVersionDescriptionAide: The product-page text, the one read before buying. The summary stays the short hook used on cards. Clearing the field erases the description.
admin.avisSousTitre: Reviews left on book pages, read before they appear.
admin.avisMotifAide: This reason is shown to its author, under their review, and to them alone. They can then correct their text: the correction puts it back in the queue by itself.
admin.avisSupprimerAide: Rejecting keeps the review and lets its author correct it. Deleting erases it, and gives them back the right to write another one for this title.
admin.temoignagesSousTitre: The quotes on the home page. They speak of the site, not of one title.
admin.temoignageAide: The home page shows the first three published testimonials, in the given order. A testimonial without French text cannot be published.
admin.temoignageTexteAide: Leaving a text empty DELETES that language version. French is required to publish; English falls back to French when missing.
admin.temoignageRoleAide: What appears under the signature: "Mother of two", for instance.
admin.temoignageCree: Testimonial created. It stays a draft until published.
admin.temoignageDepublie: Testimonial removed from the home page.

souscription.sansEngagement: Cancel any time, from your account.

simulation.banniereCorps: Nothing will be charged. This site currently runs without a payment provider: settlements are simulated, but everything else — entitlement checks, granting, receipts — happens for real.
simulation.corps: A real provider produces three outcomes, and all three deserve a screen. The main button simulates success; the other two are there to exercise what happens next.
